notes: Distinct vehicles in the first 5 seconds of I24V highway2 (data/i24v_highway2_5s.jsonl; frames 0-148 at 29.97 fps, since the window end is exclusive). Hand-counted from frames every 0.5s plus frames 8, 140, 144 and 148: 16 vehicles in the right-hand lanes moving away from the camera (a car carrier, a semi, a flatbed, two pickups and 11 cars) and 4 in the left-hand lanes. A second red car whose front only edges into the bottom-left corner in the final frames is not counted, so the label could be 21 under a looser rule.
